Harappan Gujarat: cities, water and trade

A six-day private journey to Lothal and Dholavira

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and starting point. We prepare a day-by-day itinerary and a quotation, and revise both until they suit you. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

Two of the best-known Harappan sites: the dock town of Lothal and the walled city of Dholavira with its reservoirs. The distances are long, so the nights are planned around them.

Everything is arranged privately for you: dates, pace, hotels, transport and the language you are guided in. You receive a day-by-day itinerary and an itemised quotation before you commit.

What it covers

  • Ahmedabad
  • Lothal
  • To Kachchh
  • Dholavira

Day by day

  1. Day 1: Ahmedabad

    Arrival and a briefing on the evidence.

  2. Day 2: Lothal

    The site and its interpretations, then back to Ahmedabad.

  3. Day 3: To Kachchh

    A travel day with an overnight stop.

  4. Day 4: Dholavira

    A full day at the city, its gates and its water system.

  5. Day 5: Landscape and crafts

    Water and settlement in Kachchh, and local crafts with makers who have agreed to host you.

  6. Day 6: Return

    The drive back and departure.

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.

Programmes in this journey

  • Lothal: Harappan Trade and Its Interpretations
  • Dholavira: Harappan Urbanism in Kachchh
  • The first cities: the Indus and its contemporaries
